prompt: A diver is $30$ feet **below** sea level. Represent this as an integer.
hint: Integers can show direction as well as size. Decide which direction from sea level counts as positive and which as negative.

hints.text: Integers can show direction as well as size. Decide which direction from sea level counts as positive and which as negative.
Sea level is $0$. Heights above it are positive and depths below it are negative, so attach the correct sign to $30$.
The diver is below sea level, so the integer is $-30$.

explanation: Sea level is the reference point, so it is represented by the integer $0$.
Positions above sea level are positive and positions below sea level are negative.
The diver is $30$ feet below, so the size is $30$ and the sign is negative.
The integer that represents the diver's position is $-30$.
